thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - route /v1/generate | region=eu-west | error-rate=18% | spike in 502/500 responses
Miguel: ack. I'm taking primary. Starting with routing and DNS checks.
Maya: watching proxy logs now, lots of backend unreachable errors then immediate retries to us-west nodes.
Dan: smart-routing seems to flip targets every ~30s, looks like an oscillation between eu-west and us-west.
Eva: quick check in cloud DNS: found A records pointing to decomm edge hosts (edge-eu-legacy-*) still present, TTL 86400. Inventory shows those nodes removed weeks ago.
Miguel: that would explain clients resolving to dead endpoints even though our LB health-checks have removed them.
Dan: fallback policy: when region_health < 0.8 we pick alternate region. But because some health probes are hitting stale DNS names, routing selects wrong targets.
support_lead: customer-impact: tenant-a and tenant-b seeing intermittent failures in prod. Account team elevated to P1.
Miguel: hypothesis: stale DNS entries + long TTL -> requests hit removed hosts -> smart-routing falls back cross-region -> selects a quantized variant in other region (gptx-32-int8) that doesn't have the expected tokenizer mapping -> malformed outputs / 500s.
Eva: I can remove the orphan records, need emergency approval to modify cloud-dns zone now.
Dan: mitigation plan (short): 1) disable cross-region fallbacks 2) pin affected tenants to stable eu-west model variant 3) delete orphan DNS records 4) purge CDN caches for eu-west prefixes 5) set temporary low TTLs for edge records
Miguel: flipping routing.policy.cross_region.enabled=false (dry-run then commit).
ops-bot: config-push started by Miguel
Miguel: config-push succeeded, cross-region fallbacks disabled. :white_check_mark:
Maya: patching tenant routing: model-route -> gptx-32/stable-eu for tenant-a and tenant-b (applied).
Corinne: drafting customer comms: "We've applied temporary mitigations: disabled cross-region fallbacks, pinned stable model in eu-west, purged edge caches. Monitoring; expect recovery within ~30-45m." Approve? (react: :eyes:)
support_lead: send to tenant-a now and include incident channel + retry steps.
Miguel: Eva, you have approval to remove orphan records. Proceed.
Eva: running removal transaction:
```
# cloud-dns remove orphan records
gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=edge-eu
gcloud dns record-sets transaction remove --name=edge-eu-legacy-01.redwood-inference.com. --type=A --ttl=86400 --zone=edge-eu
gcloud dns record-sets transaction execute --zone=edge-eu
```
Eva: records removed. DNS propagation may respect old TTLs for some resolvers, but most will pick up the update quickly. :rocket:
Maya: initiating CDN purge for /v1/generate on eu-west edge prefix.
ops-bot: cdn-purge completed
Dan: error-rate trending down 18% -> 2% over last 4m.
Miguel: rolling restart of eu-west edge-proxy processes to clear any local DNS caches. Rolling by 2 nodes.
ops-bot: restart job queued (10 nodes).
Miguel: first pair restarted, health checks OK.
sre_pager: oncall-handoff reminder - Miguel primary for next 30m, handoff to Maya at +30m.
Miguel: noted, I'll handoff at 16:20 UTC. Severity set to Sev2 (partial customer impact, mitigated).
Maya: running post-checks: 100 sample prompts to tenant-a/tenant-b against pinned variant. All samples returning correctly.
Dan: added log sample for RCA:
```
[2026-03-15T16:05:12Z] proxy[euw1] -> 502 backend unreachable
[retry] -> fallback selected region=us-west variant=gptx-32-int8
response: 500 malformed tokenizer mapping: missing token id map
```
Corinne: CS update sent to tenant-a/tenant-b: "Temporary mitigations applied; please retry. We'll follow up with permanent fixes." (react: :thumbsup:)
Miguel: filing follow-up tickets: ENG-DNS for reconciliation job, ENG-RUNTIME for compatibility checks before fallback, and OPs for TTL policy during deployments.
Dan: root cause summary: inventory drift left orphaned DNS records + long TTLs; smart-routing fallback lacked model-compatibility validation and selected an incompatible quantized variant in another region leading to errors.
Corinne: action items: 1) implement variant-compatibility check in fallback decision 2) periodic DNS-to-inventory reconciliation 3) reduce default edge record TTLs during deploy windows 4) add alerting for DNS inventory drift.
Miguel: handing off to Maya now. I'll stay on stand-by for 30 mins.
Maya: acked, taking primary. I'll own monitoring and the postmortem doc.
support_lead: closing customer tickets as fixed pending final confirmation from CS.
Dan: one-liner for postmortem start: "DNS inventory drift + fallback-policy gap caused cross-region misroutes and incompatible model variant selection; mitigations: disabled cross-region fallback, pinned stable variants, removed orphan DNS records, purged caches, rolling restarts."
